headline: Local Protest Leader Refused Entry to Tiranga Yatra for Carrying Three-Foot-Long Telescopic Selfie Stick
body:
A local protest leader was barred from participating in a state-level Tiranga Yatra on Tuesday after security personnel at the entry checkpoint flagged a collapsible telescopic pole as a potential threat to national aesthetics. Despite the leader’s impassioned pleas that the device was essential for capturing 'cinematic low-angle shots' of his own participation, officials maintained that no tripod-adjacent equipment is permitted within the secure zone of the procession.

'We have clear guidelines regarding flags, banners, and footwear, but the rulebook says nothing about high-definition gimbal support systems,' said the Chief Coordination Officer of the event, Rameshwar Lal. 'He argued that he was merely documenting the event for his social media followers, but when he attempted to attach an external ring light to the pole, the perimeter security had no choice but to intervene for the sake of the parade's visual integrity.'

Following the standoff, the leader reportedly staged a peaceful protest against the 'anti-influencer policies' of the organizing committee while sitting on the pavement outside the barricades. Supporters were seen providing him with a portable power bank as he livestreamed his grievances, eventually agreeing to collapse his equipment to a 'regulation size' of six inches before being granted entry to the periphery of the march.
caption: A peaceful Tiranga Yatra took a turn for the dramatic when a local leader’s selfie-stick ambitions clashed with parade security protocols. The struggle for the perfect angle continues. #TirangaYatra #Drama #SocialMediaLife #Jharkhand (satire)
